jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

You are going to start your day by going through the upcoming reviews. You will carry out a final review of the participant commitments, carry out a short consultation with the project managers responsible and finally check the completeness of the review documentation. After the review meeting, you’ll briefly summarize the results and distribute them to the participants. Later in the day, you take care of the follow-up of the agreed measures from the reviews. All in all, you are responsible for overseeing and improving the global quality of products during the development cycle by establishing and securing quality standards.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Definition, ownership and consistent application of the review process across product development and order-specific adaptations of standard components
* Maintenance and continuous improvement of the review checklist including review questions, assignment to review steps and definition of inclusive reviewer groups
* Joint preparation of reviews with project management including finalization of participant lists and timely, transparent invitation of all relevant stakeholders
* Verification of completeness, quality and timely availability of review documentation to enable equal access to information for all reviewers
* Facilitation and moderation of reviews including validation of reviewer presence, focus-driven discussion guidance, structured decision-making and clear documentation of review outcomes
* Monitoring and tracking of agreed measures and follow-up actions including preparation and coordination of subsequent reviews to ensure sustainable implementation and goal achievement

What You Bring

* A completed technical degree in mechanical engineering or comparable
* Several years of professional experience in the field of quality and process management
* Fluency in German and English, both written and spoken
* Strong teamwork, communication and analytical skills in diverse and cross-functional environments
* High level of ownership, accountability and motivation to take responsibility for assigned topics and outcomes
* Structured and reliable working style with strong focus on meeting deadlines and solution-oriented, calm moderation of critical discussions
* Willingness to travel (> 20 %)

 

About the Team

In our Transformation of Industry division, we offer comprehensive digital portfolio solutions in the oil and gas sector and other process industries comprising rotating equipment, electrification, and solutions for the Subsea business. Our customers are supported with sustainable and mission-critical products, solutions, and services.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits

The Research Engineer will contribute to driving R&D initiatives within a dynamic industrial setting, focusing on the development of new products, services, and basic knowledge of steel casting fluxes (mold powder for continuous casting of steel) and raw materials. The role encompasses applications in continuous casting of steel. This position bridges laboratory research and plant operations, emphasizing sustainable solutions, process efficiencies, and delivering high-quality results for industrial clients worldwide.

Responsibilities:

1. Project Management :

- Define research programs aligned with new product and service objectives.
- Organize and execute laboratory-scale R&D projects.
- Performs tasks/projects and takes the responsibility for assuring quality, cost effectiveness & timeliness for those projects
- Develop materials and processes while supporting related projects.
- Maintain regular reporting on project progress and outcomes.
- Supervise customer sample preparation and optimize products based on feedback.
- Monitor technical advancements in the market, including patents and scientific publications.
- Consolidate fundamental knowledge on steel casting fluxes and associated raw materials.

2. Laboratory Research and Data Management :

- Plan research activities, including experiments, characterization, and analytics
- Manage, process, analyse, and document data from lab activities.
- Maximize data collection value from R&D, production, and quality assurance.
- Develop project reviews, technical reports, and presentations with clarity and precision.
- Document knowledge and findings in technical memos and share them with stakeholders.
- Utilize project management tools (e.g., Vantage) for deliverables and resource planning.
- Organize stage-gate meetings and prioritize multiple projects.

3. External Collaboration and Scientific Contributions :

- Prepare papers, proposals, and presentations for conferences, congresses, and seminars.
- Build external collaborations and networks to share and extend expertise.
- Address intellectual property topics, support evaluations, and assist in patent filings.

Requirements: 

- PhD or master’s degree in Materials Science, Metallurgy, Mineralogy, or a related engineering discipline, preferably with a focus on casting fluxes (mold powders), glass chemistry, and/or interactions between slag and liquid steel.
- Minimum of 5 years of experience in R&D, project management, or product development, ideally within or for a steel plant environment.
- Comprehensive knowledge of continuous steel casting processes, mineralogy, and ceramic raw materials for casting fluxes, including their melting and solidification mechanisms under high-temperature conditions.
- Strong expertise in thermodynamics and reaction kinetics, with proficiency in thermodynamic calculation tools (e.g., FactSage®).
- Hands-on experience with advanced analytical techniques, such as high-temperature viscometry, hot-stage microscopy, TG/DTA, XRD, and Rietveld refinement.
- Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities, with demonstrated experience in data analysis and interpretation.
- Strong technical writing and presentation skills, including the ability to clearly summarize research outcomes and present results during stage-gate or project review meetings.
- Motivated, adaptable, and innovative, with a proactive approach to challenges and a strong drive for continuous improvement.
- Collaborative mindset, with the ability to work effectively in an international environment and partner across R&D and plant operations.
- Fluency in German and English, both written and spoken.

jobs.occupation: Researcher wanted for the Department of Depression and Anxiety, Aarhus University Hospital / Forsker søges til Afdeling For Depression og Angst, AUH
jobs.description:
Forskningsenheden under Afdeling for Depression og Angst (ADA) ved Aarhus Universitetshospital søger kandidater til en tidsbegrænset stilling (18 måneder) pr. 01. december 2026 som forsker med fokus på udvikling af maskinlæringsalgoritmer til forudsigelse af kliniske outcomes hos patienter med psykisk sygdom.

Om forskningsenheden

ADA er en del af Aarhus Universitetshospital. Vii tilbyder udredning og behandling af høj faglig kvalitet til voksne patienter med lidelser inden for det affektive spektrum. Afdelingens forskningsenhed består af en professor samt ca. 20 fuldtids- og deltidsforskere. Forskningsenheden har stor faglig diversitet og rummer bl.a. læger, psykologer, sygeplejersker, programmører og en statistiker.

Arbejdsopgaver

Arbejdsopgaverne vil bl.a. omfatte

• selvstændig forskning med fokus på udvikling og validering af maskinlæringsalgoritmer
• publikation af forskningsresultater
• sparring med øvrige forskere i Forskningsenheden
• bidrag til fondsansøgninger
• deltagelse ved seminarer og konferencer
• vejledning af yngre forskere og studerende.
Vi tilbyder

• en stilling i et stærkt tværfagligt forskningsmiljø
• tæt samarbejde med kliniske miljøer
• mulighed for nationale og internationale samarbejder.
Ønskede faglige kvalifikationer

• erfaring med forskning i maskinlæring med anvendelse af sundhedsdata (ideelt journaldata)
• formel forskningsuddannelse
• erfaring med publikation af forskningsdata i tidsskrifter med peer review
• stærke samarbejdskompetencer og erfaring med tværgående samarbejde

Ansættelsesforhold

Researcher

The research unit of the Department of Affective Disorders at Aarhus University Hospital is seeking candidates for a fixed-term position (18 months) as researcher with a focus on developing machine learning algorithms to predict clinical outcomes in patients with mental illness.

About the research unit

The Department of Affective Disorders is part of Aarhus University Hospital. We offer high-quality assessment and treatment for adult patients with affective disorders. The department's research unit consists of a professor and approximately 20 full-time and part-time researchers. The research unit has substantial professional diversity and includes, among others, doctors, psychologists, nurses, programmers and a statistician.

Tasks

• independent research with a focus on the development and validation of machine learning algorithms
• publication of research results
• sparring with other researchers in the research unit
• contribution to grant applications
• participation in seminars and conferences
• supervision of younger researchers and students.
We offer

• a strong interdisciplinary research environment
• close collaboration with clinical colleagues
• opportunity for national and international collaborations.
Desired professional qualifications

• experience with research in machine learning using health data (ideally medical record data)
• formal research training
• experience with publication of research data in peer-reviewed journals
• strong collaboration skills and experience with interdisciplinary collaboration
• understands, speaks and can write Danish and English (A main data source is medical record text in Danish).
Employment conditions

This is a full-time, fixed-term position (18 months) starting on December 1st, 2026.

Salary and employment conditions in accordance with the applicable collective agreement. The employment is conditioned by a satifying child criminal record.

Further information about the position can be obtained by contacting Professor Søren Dinesen Østergaard at +45 6128 2753 or by mail soeoes@rm.dk.

Application deadline is September 22nd 2026 and the interviews are expected to be held on September 24th, 2026.

Help us build QWC’s new Rope Access Department

QWC.dk ApS is a Danish window cleaning and specialist access company based in Glostrup. We carry out professional window cleaning, glass restoration and complex assignments where specialist access methods are required.

We are now establishing a dedicated rope access department and are looking for an experienced, proactive and hands-on IRATA Level 3 Rope Access Supervisor who wants to help build the department from the beginning.

The position

As our Level 3 Rope Access Supervisor, you will be responsible for the daily planning, supervision and safe execution of QWC’s rope access operations.

The position combines on-site supervision, practical rope access work, safety planning and client communication. You will work alongside the team and play a central role in developing our procedures, equipment setup and working methods.

You will have the authority and responsibility to stop any operation that you consider unsafe.

Main responsibilities

Your responsibilities will include:

• 
Planning and supervising rope access operations at sites throughout Denmark

• 
Preparing and maintaining risk assessments, APV documentation, method statements and rescue plans

• 
Conducting pre-work briefings and toolbox talks

• 
Ensuring that all work is carried out safely and in accordance with Danish legislation, QWC procedures and applicable IRATA standards

• 
Selecting and checking rope access systems, rigging and anchor points within your professional competence

• 
Establishing exclusion zones and protecting clients, employees and members of the public

• 
Supervising rope access technicians and verifying that team members have the necessary qualifications and competence

• 
Inspecting, controlling and documenting rope access equipment and personal protective equipment

• 
Planning emergency and rescue procedures

• 
Communicating with clients before, during and after assignments

• 
Participating directly in practical rope access work, including window cleaning and specialist façade and glass assignments

• 
Assisting with other window cleaning operations during periods without scheduled rope access work

• 
Helping QWC develop a professional, efficient and safety-focused rope access department

Your qualifications

We expect that you:

• 
Hold a valid IRATA Level 3 certificate

• 
Have an up-to-date and correctly maintained IRATA logbook

• 
Hold a current and relevant first aid certificate

• 
Have practical experience supervising rope access operations

• 
Have strong knowledge of risk assessment, rescue planning, equipment control and safe systems of work

• 
Can communicate professionally in spoken and written English

• 
Can communicate clearly with technicians, management and clients

• 
Are proactive, responsible and comfortable making safety-critical decisions

• 
Take a practical approach and are willing to work alongside the team

• 
Can work independently and remain calm in demanding situations

• 
Are willing to travel to different work locations throughout Denmark

• 
Are physically capable of carrying out rope access work

Danish language skills are an advantage, but they are not a requirement. English is required.

Experience with window cleaning, façade cleaning, building maintenance or similar specialist work is an advantage, but it is not a requirement.

Employment terms

• 
Position: IRATA Level 3 Rope Access Supervisor

• 
Employment: Full-time

• 
Working hours: 37 hours per week

• 
Salary payment: Monthly in arrears

• 
Primary base: QWC.dk ApS, Glostrup, Denmark

• 
Place of work: Various client locations throughout Denmark

• 
Holiday entitlement: In accordance with the Danish Holiday Act

• 
Start date: As soon as possible or by agreement

• 
Notice periods: In accordance with the employment contract and applicable Danish law

Employment is conditional upon the candidate obtaining and maintaining any residence and work permit required to work legally in Denmark.

About QWC

QWC is a growing Danish window cleaning company with extensive experience in professional window cleaning and challenging specialist assignments. We focus on high-quality work, professional communication and safe, practical solutions.

This is an opportunity to join us at an early stage in the development of our new rope access department and have real influence on how the department is built and operated.

How to apply

Please send the following in English:

• 
Your CV

• 
A short application

• 
A copy of your valid IRATA Level 3 certificate

• 
Documentation of your current first aid qualification

• 
A summary of your relevant rope access and supervisory experience

Send your application to kontakt@qwc.dk with the subject line:

“IRATA Level 3 Rope Access Supervisor”

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis.

jobs.occupation: Tenure-track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor of Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing
jobs.description:
Tenure-track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor of Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing
 Department of Food Science
 Faculty of Science
 University of Copenhagen

  The Department of Food Science (FOOD), Faculty of Science (SCIENCE), University of Copenhagen (UCPH) invites applications for a position as Tenure-track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor in Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing. The research areas of FOOD have a shared mission to contribute to new pathways for society and industry to support the development of solutions based in biology to improve sustainable food production, food security and food safety. FOOD is recognized for excellence in food research, education and industrial collaboration. The Department is an international workplace with Danish and English as parallel working languages, however it is expected that the successful candidate will be able to contribute to teaching in Danish within 3 to 6 years. FOOD has the ambition to reinforce our teaching and research in designing and optimizing biology-based solutions as future sustainable food and ingredient technologies. UCPH is strengthening this area by offering the new MSc Biosolutions program in Kalundborg, Denmark, the largest bio-based manufacturing hub in Scandinavia, home to large fermentation-based manufacturers, and a vibrant innovation environment. The candidate for this position is expected to significantly contribute to this new Biosolutions initiative.

  The aim of the position is to explore the production and use of new solutions based on both biology and engineering addressing sustainability challenges inherent in food systems today. Although we welcome a diverse range of applicants, the focus of the position will be processing in relation to biochemically based solutions and could include the following disciplines:

   	
• Food process technology, ideally with an emphasis on fermentation & downstream processing 	
• Food process system engineering 	
• Use of sensor technologies such as in-line or at line spectroscopic tools 	
• Large-data, modelling and prediction of food and ingredient processes. 	
• Understanding of biological production systems and their use, and with an emphasis on downstream processing     A central part of the activities anchored to this position will be taking place in Campus Kalundborg, and it is crucial that the candidate is able to leverage the local ecosystem to foster strong collaboration with industry. Qualifications are expected in the following areas:

   	
• A collaborative and innovative mindset 	
• Documented scientific impact and outreach in past research work 	
• A proven track record in attracting external funding at both national and international level 	
• Experience with international collaborations 	
• Ability to establish industrial collaboration 	
• Excellent interpersonal and communicative skills   Tenure-track assistant professor
 The tenure-track assistant professor’s duties will primarily include research, including obligations regarding publication/scientific communication and research-based teaching with associated examination obligations within Ingredient Biochemical Processing. To a limited extent the position may also include other duties.

  The tenure-track assistant professor must have an academic standing showing internationally competitive research, and/or have internationally recognized high potential to make a future impact.

  Assessment of applicants for the tenure-track assistant professorship will primarily consider their level of documented, internationally competitive research. The ability to attract external funding will be considered together with outreach qualifications. Teaching qualifications are not mandatory but documented teaching qualifications and teaching experience will be considered.

  Associate professor

  Applicants are required to have university level teaching experience, documented teaching competencies and must be able to explain and reflect upon own teaching practice and portfolio. Formal pedagogical training or supervision equivalent to the University of Copenhagen teacher training programme for assistant professors is required.
 
 The candidate must be an inspiring teacher with a vision on teaching development, especially in connection with the new MSc Biosolutions program. A new campus with research and teaching facilities is currently being built in Kalundborg and the candidate is expected to contribute to setting up the facilities

  Duties include the applicant’s own research, development of the field, assessment tasks, grant applications, and research management such as supervision and training of research fellows and other staff. The successful applicant must also teach, supervise, prepare and participate in examinations, and fulfill other tasks requested by the Department.

  Assessment of applicants for the associate professorship will primarily consider their level of documented, original scientific production at an international level, including contributions to developments in their field, as well as their documented teaching qualifications. Managerial and out-reach qualifications of applicants including ability to attract external funding will also be considered.

  University of Copenhagen’s criteria for recognising merit
 General criteria apply to the appointment of assistant professor / associate professor at the University of Copenhagen. The criteria (research, teaching, Innovation & societal impact, organizational contribution and leadership) are considered as a framework for an overall assessment of the applicant. In addition, each applicant will be assessed according to the specific requirements listed in this advertisement.

  Please read more here
 
 For tenure-track assistant professors: https://jobportal.ku.dk/videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-meritering-maj-2026/5a_Criteria_for_recognising_merit_-Assistant_professors.pdf

  For associate professors: https://jobportal.ku.dk/videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-meritering-maj-2026/5b_Criteria_for_recognising_merit_-Associate_professors.pdf

  Applicants are encouraged to read the University of Copenhagen's Guidance on the merit criterion Innovation and Societal Impact here

  The tenure-track assistant programme
 The tenure-track programme is a career programme and an assigned mentor will provide the tenure-track assistant professors with guidance related to career development, other academic topics and administrative procedures.

  Performance of the tenure-track assistant professor will be followed via internal yearly evaluations and a mid-term and final international evaluation by an assessment committee. If the ‘final appraisal’ is positive you will be promoted as associate professor. Performance and progression towards the criteria below will be evaluated with due consideration of differences between research fields.

  After a 6-year tenure-track period tenure-track assistant professors are expected to meet the criteria for appointment of associate professors at the University of Copenhagen.

  Salary and employment conditions
 The position is open from 1 May 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. 

  The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff.

  Employment is as either tenure track assistant professor or associate professor under the applicable collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. There will be an opportunity to negotiate supplements based on qualifications. You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

  The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

  The Professor will be a part of the Section for Ingredients and Dairy Technology. The section has internationally acknowledged expertise within novel sustainable processing technologies, protein, polyphenol and lipid chemistry, functionality, and modification of food components, kinetics, oxidation, food engineering, rheology, digitalisation, and advanced data analysis. The section is also equipped with pilot facilities for brewing, dairy and bioprocessing.  Further information on the Department is linked at Department of Food Science – University of Copenhagen Inquiries about the position can be made to Inquiries about the position can be made to Head of Department, Colin Ray (+45 93565911, colin.ray@food.ku.dk) or Head of Section, Mogens Larsen Andersen (+45 3533 3262, mola@food.ku.dk).

  Filing of application
 The position may be applied for at the tenure-track assistant professor level or associate professor level. Please note that it is possible to apply at more than one level. If applied at more than one level, separate applications must be submitted (see below).

  The application including all attachments must be in English and submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below. 

  Applying for the tenure-track assistant professorship please include 

   	
• Curriculum vitae including: 	 		
• Please describe and document international network and relations 		
• Please describe and document internationally based activities 		
• Positions held at universities/research institutions outside Denmark 		
• Outreach activities, i.e. popular lectures or other activities in the media 		
• Grants held, personal or in part. Career development grants. 	 	 	
• Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent)    	
• Research plan - description of current and future research plans    	
• If available, description and documentation of teaching and supervision experience and qualifications- please describe and document: 	 		
• Experience with supervision of BSc and MSc students 		
• Teaching experience 		
• Formal pedagogical training 	 	    	
• Complete publication list 	
• Separate reprints of up to 5 particularly relevant papers   Applying for the associate professorship please include 

   	
• Curriculum vitae including information about external funding  	
• Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent)  	
• Research plan – description of current and future research plans  	
• Description and documentation of teaching experience and qualifications according to university guidelines 	
• Complete publication list 	
• Separate reprints of 5 particularly relevant papers   The deadline for applications is 28 October 2026, 23:59 GMT +1.

  After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Interview Committee.  

  You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/.

  Interviews will be held on 8 March 2027.  

  Please refer to the following no. in future communication in this case: 

  211-0263/26-2N, Tenure-track Assistant Professor Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing.

  211-0760/26-2E, Associate Professor of Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing.

Tenure-track Assistant Professor, Associate Professor or Full Professor of Food Processing & Technology
Department of Food Science
Faculty of Science
University of Copenhagen

The Department of Food Science, Faculty of Science, University of Copenhagen invites applications for a position as Tenure-track Assistant Professor, Associate Professor or Full Professor in Food Processing and Technology. Applicants must be capable of, and interested in, conducting and developing basic and applied interdisciplinary research of high international standard in the field of food processing and technology. The position will involve extensive collaborations within the department and with national and international academic groups and industrial partners. Research within the Department has a mission to unearth new solutions for society and industry to support sustainable food production, food security and safety as well as production of high-quality food promoting human health and wellbeing. The Department of Food Science is recognized for excellence in food research, education, and industrial collaborations. The Department is an international workplace with Danish and English as parallel working languages, however it is expected that the successful candidate will be able to contribute to teaching in Danish within 3 to 6 years. We encourage applications from a range of disciplines within the food science and technology area, ideally covering the understanding of food macromolecular interactions on a mechanistic level, how processing and formulation affect or determine these interactions, and how this influences final product quality with focus on functional properties.

We are seeking a candidate who will establish an internationally leading research program, and we encourage a diverse range of applicants whose work may center on one or more of the following disciplines:

• 
Developing a mechanistic understanding of interactions of food macromolecules in complex matrices during processing or formulation spanning dairy, plant, and single-cell protein sources.

• 
How this knowledge can be used in the rational design of functional ingredients and healthy foods using established and emerging processing technologies

• 
Development and utilization of high throughput methods for characterizing and quantifying the physicochemical behavior of food macromolecules in complex matrices.

• 
Modelling and the use of machine learning/AI for simulation and prediction of the outcome of process unit operations on food and ingredient functionality.

• 
Formulation and fluid dynamics of complex emulsions and the mechanisms governing this.

 In addition, it is expected that this position will be involved in a significant amount of collaboration with industry, and therefore it is expected that the successful candidate has a documented successful track record in industry collaboration and working with innovation-oriented research. Furthermore, we expect that the successful candidate has a genuine interest in leadership and the wellbeing and development of their group.

Tenure-track assistant professor
The tenure-track assistant professor’s duties will primarily include research, including obligations with regards to publication/scientific communication and research-based teaching with associated examination obligations within the Tenure Track Assistant Professorship. To a limited extent the position may also include other duties.

The tenure-track assistant professor must have an academic standing showing internationally competitive research, and/or have internationally recognized high potential to make a future impact.

Assessment of applicants for the tenure-track assistant professorship will primarily consider their level of documented, internationally competitive research. The ability to attract external funding will be considered together with outreach qualifications. Teaching qualifications are not mandatory but documented teaching qualifications and teaching experience will be considered.

Associate professor and full professor

Applicants are required to have university level teaching experience, documented teaching competencies and must be able to explain and reflect upon own teaching practice and portfolio. Formal pedagogical training or supervision equivalent to the University of Copenhagen teacher training programme for assistant professors is required.
In particular, the candidate must actively contribute with research-based teaching on the BSc in Food Science and Nutrition, and the MSc in Food Science and Technology programs, with an emphasis on the specialization in Dairy Science and Technology.

Duties include the applicant’s own research, development of the field, assessment tasks, grant applications, and research management such as supervision and training of research fellows and other staff. The successful applicant must also teach, supervise, prepare and participate in examinations, and fulfill other tasks requested by the Department.

Assessment of applicants for the associate professorship and full professorship will primarily consider their level of documented, original scientific production at an international level, including contributions to developments in their field, as well as their documented teaching qualifications. Managerial and out-reach qualifications of applicants including ability to attract external funding will also be considered.

University of Copenhagen’s criteria for recognising merit
General criteria apply to the appointment of assistant professor / associate professor / professor at the University of Copenhagen. The criteria (research, teaching, Innovation & societal impact, organizational contribution and leadership) are considered as a framework for an overall assessment of the applicant. In addition, each applicant will be assessed according to the specific requirements listed in this advertisement.

jobs.occupation: Workshop Mechanic - Gadbjerg, near Vejle, Denmark
jobs.description:
About us

We run a workshop about 15 km from Vejle in East Jutland, Denmark, in close partnership between GMT and Nordic Rebar ApS. You will be employed by Nordic Rebar ApS, which is based at the workshop.
GMT trades in used machinery for the rebar industry and is a well-known player in the industry across most of the world.
Together, we hold a large stock of used machines that continuously need to be inspected and refurbished, and we are therefore looking for a mechanic who will make the workshop his or her permanent base.

About the job

As a workshop mechanic, you will be responsible for keeping the workshop running and the machines in good order. Your tasks will include:

-Repair and preparation of used machines for the rebar industry
-Loading and unloading machines and accessories using a forklift truck (a valid forklift/truck licence is required)
-General maintenance and tidiness in the workshop

The workshop has an office attached to it, so you will have good colleagues around you, and we have lunch together.

The workshop has modern facilities, including a laser cleaner for removing rust and dirt, and we place great emphasis on the work being carried out safely and properly.

In the workshop itself you will typically be the only mechanic on a daily basis, so you must be able to plan and carry out your tasks independently.
 
We expect you to

-Have a technical/trade background, e.g. as a car or truck mechanic, industrial electrician, or mechatronics technician, with good mechanical aptitude
-Have at least 10 years of relevant work experience
-Hold a valid forklift/truck licence
-Be responsible and have a can-do attitude
-Be able to work independently and organise your own working day
-Not be afraid of getting dirty
-Understand and speak English
-Be an EU citizen
 
Terms of employment

This is a permanent position with Nordic Rebar ApS, on the terms and under the rules and legislation applicable in Denmark.
-Starting salary: EUR 25 per hour, paid monthly
-Weekly working hours: 37 hours - overtime may occur and can possibly be compensated with time off, among other things to allow for more frequent trips home, if needed
-Start date: as soon as possible
-Workplace: Gadbjerg, approx. 15 km from Vejle
-Accommodation (a smaller apartment/room) can be arranged locally - expected rent approx. DKK 4,000-5,000 per month max
 
Application

Applications should be sent by e-mail to ud@gmtaps.com.

Questions are welcome and can be directed to Ulrich Deichmann, GMT, tel. +45 20 98 94 44, or Arne Hansen, Nordic Rebar ApS, tel. +45 51 46 20 50.

We offer an exciting opportunity in a company where you will become part of an international supply chain, working with customers such as BMW, Audi, Mercedes, Rolls-Royce and many others. Every day, we are committed to ensuring that our warehouse and logistics processes meet our customers' requirements while supporting efficient production.

As a Warehouse & Logistics Operator, you will play an important role in our daily operations. Your primary responsibilities will include receiving, registering, and dispatching goods while ensuring accurate inventory management and an efficient material flow. You will also contribute to optimizing logistics processes and maintaining high standards of quality, organization, and safety in the warehouse.

Primary Responsibilities

• 
Receive and register incoming goods.

• 
Inspect deliveries and verify quality upon receipt.

• 
Maintain and optimize warehouse organization to ensure efficiency and visibility.

• 
Prepare outbound shipments.

• 
Take responsibility for the day's shipments.

• 
Coordinate daily deliveries and collections with colleagues.

• 
Contribute to the continuous improvement of warehouse procedures and workflows.

• 
Ensure correct packaging and the quality of materials.

• 
Maintain a safe, clean, and organized warehouse environment.

• 
Assist with planning material flow and warehouse optimization. 

We Are Looking for Someone Who

• 
Holds a Category C (Large Goods Vehicle) driving licence. An EU Driver Certificate of Professional Competence (CPC) and a valid driver card are considered an advantage. Truck driving will be a smaller part of the role but is an important qualification.

• 
Has experience in warehouse operations, logistics, or goods receiving.

• 
Works in a structured manner and takes ownership of assigned tasks.

• 
Holds a valid forklift licence/certificate.

• 
Has experience working with ERP systems and is generally comfortable using IT systems.

• 
Is service-minded, flexible, and enjoys working as part of a team.

• 
Can remain organized and maintain an overview, even in a fast-paced

• 
 environment.

• 
Can communicate in Danish, English and/or German.

What We Offer

• 
An exciting position in a company supplying solutions to the automotive industry.

• 
A positive working environment with supportive and dedicated colleagues.

• 
The opportunity to influence the development of warehouse operations and working procedures.

• 
A high level of responsibility and autonomy.

• 
A full-time position of 37 hours per week.

• 
Flexible working hours; however, our greatest need for additional staff is between 2:00 PM and 10:00 PM.

Start Date

We are looking to fill the position as soon as possible. The vacancy will close once we have found the right candidate.

Interested?

For more information about this position, please contact Patricia Simens Thuesen at patricia.thuesen@alunited.dk.

Please send your application and CV as soon as possible via Jobindex. We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis and will hire as soon as we find the right candidate.

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.occupation: We're Hiring: 2 Ventilation Installers / Diamond Drillers (Training Provided)
jobs.description:
Balling Ventilation – Denmark (Zealand & Funen)

Balling Ventilation is a busy Danish ventilation and contracting company based in Stenløse, working across Zealand (Sjælland) and Funen (Fyn). We install ventilation systems in homes and buildings – from single-room units and heat recovery systems (MVHR) to crawl space ventilation and radon mitigation – and we do a lot of diamond core drilling.

We are growing fast and need 2 new colleagues to start as soon as possible.

Who we're looking for

• 
Bricklayers (murere) who want to learn diamond core drilling and ventilation installation, or

• 
Other skilled trades (carpenters, electricians, plumbers, general construction workers, etc.) who are motivated to learn ventilation work and diamond drilling

No prior ventilation experience required – we will train you. What matters is that you are reliable, hardworking, and want to learn a skilled trade with great long-term prospects.

What we offer

• 
Hourly wage: 180–250 DKK depending on qualifications and experience

• 
+ 12.5% holiday pay (feriepenge) on top of your wage

• 
Your own company van and tools

• 
Plenty of work: minimum 160 hours per month guaranteed – and the opportunity to work 250+ hours per month if you want to, because we are very busy

• 
Full training in ventilation installation and diamond core drilling

• 
Varied work at different sites across Zealand and Funen

Requirements

• 
Skilled trade background (bricklayer or other construction trade)

• 
Willing to relocate to Denmark – we can help by referring you to housing options

• 
Basic English as a minimum (Danish not required)

• 
Valid driver's license

• 
Ready to work hard and learn new skills

How to apply

Send a short message about yourself and your work experience to:

Zakarias Balling Eddaif  ze@ballingventilation.dk  +45 71 72 75 79

We hire on an ongoing basis, so don't wait – reach out today.

jobs.occupation: Køkkenmedhjælper til Det Danske Madhus Albertslund/Kitchen Assistant for Our Production Facility in Albertslund
jobs.description:
Til vores produktion i Albertslund søger vi en struktureret og serviceminded kollega, der trives med at arbejde i et storkøkken, hvor kvalitet, samarbejde og god stemning blandt kollegerne er i højsædet. 

Som køkkenmedarbejder hos Det Danske Madhus i Albertslund bliver du en vigtig del af vores team. 
Du får en spændende og varieret hverdag med opgaver såsom: 

• Produktion af kolde og varme retter
• Forefaldende arbejde i køkkenet
• Portionering af retter 
Hos Det Danske Madhus producerer vi dagligt mad til vores mange kunder. Vores kunder omfatter alt fra børn i institutioner og skoler til hjemmeboende ældre eller ældre på plejehjem. Vi mener at alle, uanset alder eller helbred fortjener et velsmagende måltid. 

Vi laver alt mad fra bunden, og opskrifterne er vores egne gennemprøvede opskrifter, så vi ved, vores kunder får måltider af højeste kvalitet. 

Hvem er du? 

Du har gerne tidligere erfaring med at arbejde i et køkken – fx på et hospital eller på et plejehjem. Du arbejder selvstændigt og trives i et miljø hvor der er travlt. 

Du har fokus på god hygiejne og høj kvalitet og du går ikke på kompromis med nogen af tingene. 

Du taler og skriver dansk på højt niveau. 

Hvad kan Det Danske Madhus tilbyde dig?

• Fantastiske kolleger og et stærkt sammenhold 
• Kantineordning med både morgenmad og frokost, der får dig godt igennem dagen 
• Et job omfattet af overenskomst med FOA og Kost og Ernæringsforbundet
• Attraktiv pensionsordning
• En personaleforening der står for hyggelige arrangementer, hvor vi sammen fejrer de små og store succeser
• Overskudsdeling, så du mærker, at din indsats gør en forskel 
Praktiske oplysninger

Du bliver en del af vores produktionsteam i Albertslund, hvor vi er ca. 90 medarbejdere. 

Stillingen er 37 timer pr. uge. Du arbejder mandag til fredag i tidsrummet mellem 6.00-15.00.

Lyder det som noget for dig? 

Så send os dit CV og ansøgning hurtigst muligt via ”ansøg-knappen”

Annoncen er aktiv og vi behandler ansøgninger løbende, så send dit cv allerede i dag. 

Har du nogen spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Madhuschef Kim Knudsen på mail kik@ddm.dk

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig. 

 

ENGLISH:

For our production facility in Albertslund, we are looking for a structured and service-minded colleague who thrives in a large-scale kitchen environment where quality, teamwork, and a positive working atmosphere are top priorities.

As a Kitchen Assistant at Det Danske Madhus in Albertslund, you will become an important part of our team.

You will enjoy an exciting and varied workday with tasks including:

Preparing hot and cold meals
General kitchen duties
Portioning and packaging meals

At Det Danske Madhus, we prepare meals every day for our many customers. Our customers range from children in daycare centres and schools to elderly people living at home or in nursing homes. We believe that everyone, regardless of age or health, deserves a delicious and nutritious meal.

All our food is made from scratch using our own tried and tested recipes, ensuring that our customers receive meals of the highest quality.

Who Are You?

Ideally, you have previous experience working in a kitchen environment, for example in a hospital, nursing home, or similar setting.

You are able to work independently and thrive in a busy workplace.

You have a strong focus on hygiene and quality, and you never compromise on either.

You are fluent in spoken and written Danish.

What Can Det Danske Madhus Offer You?
Fantastic colleagues and a strong sense of team spirit
A staff canteen offering both breakfast and lunch to keep you energized throughout the day
Employment covered by collective agreements with FOA and The Danish Association of Dietitians and Nutrition Professionals
An attractive pension scheme
A staff association that organizes social events where we celebrate both small and large successes together
A profit-sharing scheme, ensuring that you feel the impact of your contribution
Practical Information

You will become part of our production team in Albertslund, consisting of approximately 90 employees.

This is a full-time position (37 hours per week). Working hours are Monday to Friday between 6:00 AM and 3:00 PM.

Does This Sound Like the Right Opportunity for You?

Then send us your CV and application as soon as possible via the "Apply" button.

The position is open, and we review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to submit your CV today.

If you have any questions about the position, please feel free to contact Kitchen Manager Kim Knudsen at kik@ddm.dk.
